soldier: The soldier has the vertex brown tinged with red, the frontal surface brown with purple, the posterior margin of the head yellowish brown; labrum brown, antennae yellow, mandibles blackish brown; pronotum yellowish brown with the periphery darker, abdomen and legs pale brown. Head cylindrical, widest beside the compound eyes, narrowest at the base of the mandibles, the middle of the sides slightly contracted, the posterior margin broad and rounded. In profile the dorsolateral angle of the frons projects outwards, the frontal slope about 70 degrees, the dorsal margin of the head nearly straight. In front view two smooth pale round spots lie below the top of the frons, shaped like a pair of spectacles, the Y-shaped suture distinct. Compound eyes rather large, their distance to the antennal socket less than their own short diameter. The tip of the labrum flat and rounded; the tips of the mandibles curved, in profile the tip of the mandible sloping forwards and downwards, the left mandible less than half as long as the head capsule, the basal prominence of the mandible distinct. Antennae with 12–13 segments, the third shortest. The postmentum 6.7–7.9 times as long as the width at its waist, widest in the anterior third, the waist region in the posterior third. Pronotum narrower than the head, the anterior margin nearly straight with a shallow median notch, the posterior margin also rather flat, its median notch rather deep.
